parameters.query: SELECT version() as postgres_version, current_database() as database_name, pg_database_size(current_database()) as database_size;

-- Monitora pedidos pendentes
WITH pending_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    client_name,
    created_at,
    status,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at))/60 as minutes_waiting
  FROM receitas
  WHERE status IN ('received', 'medications_extracted', 'budget_ready')
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
),
stuck_orders AS (
  SELECT * FROM pending_orders
  WHERE 
    (status = 'received' AND minutes_waiting > 30) OR
    (status = 'medications_extracted' AND minutes_waiting > 20) OR
    (status = 'budget_ready' AND minutes_waiting > 2880)
),
expiring_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    client_name,
    created_at,
    total_amount,
    2880 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at))/60 as minutes_remaining
  FROM receitas
  WHERE status = 'budget_ready'
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '44 hours'
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pending_orders) as total_pending,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stuck_orders) as total_stuck,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expiring_orders) as total_expiring,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT stuck_orders.*) > 0 THEN json_agg(DISTINCT stuck_orders.*) ELSE '[]'::json END as stuck_orders,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT expiring_orders.*) > 0 THEN json_agg(DISTINCT expiring_orders.*) ELSE '[]'::json END as expiring_orders
FROM stuck_orders, expiring_orders;
